ok.does: confirms the name; the keyboard closes
ok.evidence: w51-confirm: 'Bobo has been sent to a Box!'

shift.does: toggles shift (one-shot: off again after one character); orange while on

to_grid.does: switches to the alphabetical grid page (strinput_grid)

notes: the page the keyboard opens on; key rects are 18 x 29 at a 20 px pitch, rows staggered by 10 px
names are the unshifted key; row 0 is ! 1-0 with shift off and ! ♂ ♀ + - * / = % ( ) with shift on
the game's own D-pad cursor (yellow box) follows the last tapped key
past the length limit (12 for a nickname) a key does nothing

to_qwerty.does: switches back to the QWERTY page

notes: alphabetical grid with CAPS / lower / Sym. tabs, Delete and OK along the bottom; only the way back is recorded (the native keyboard drives the QWERTY page)
